notes: No official register (Cuc Thu y / DAH, city vet associations) or poison line was reachable: dah.gov.vn and nonglam.edu.vn were refused by WebFetch (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED); VNUA vet hospital page (khoathuy.vnua.edu.vn) redirected http<->https without loading. Nha Trang, Da Lat, Hoi An, Phu Quoc clinics only appeared on aggregator/blog pages (olympiamedic.com, phongkhamthuy.net) and were not published; their own sites not yet opened (dalatpet.com refused). Left: Hanoi/HCMC university hospitals, Nha Trang, Da Lat (Da Lat Pet, Doctor Hi), Hoi An, Phu Quoc, Hue, Can Tho, other HCMC clinics (New Pet Hospital, Pet Pro, Petzone). No animal poison line found. Independent check 2026-11-11: all 10 source pages opened and confirmed (names, phones, 24-h wording); Animal Doctors International states 24/7 emergency for Vietnam as a whole, not per branch. Follow-up run 2026-11-11 (Nha Trang, Da Lat, Hoi An, Phu Quoc, Hue, Can Tho, universities, more HCMC): added 39 entries from clinic/university own sites. Unreachable: thuypetpro.com.vn (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED / robots disallowed; PetPro covered via petpro.com.vn), toplist.vn (robots), saigonpethospital.com (redirects to unrelated site), thuygovap.vn (redirect loop), vietnamtourism.com. Not added because only an aggregator or Facebook page exists: Home Vet Nha Trang (iigo.vn listing says 24/24, address 402 Duong 2/4, phone 0343 750 832), Pet Friends Nha Trang, Nha Trang Veterinary Hospital, Kokan Pet, Hoi An clinics (Tuoi Pet, Trinh Nguyen, Dr Quang), Hue Vet is in Hanoi, Doctor Hi Da Lat, Can Tho private clinics, Phu Quoc Dr Trang, Petzone, Belwee, Alpha Pets, Saigon Veterinary Clinic. Pet Pro (HCMC) address/phone details come from petpro.com.vn page. petclinic.vn (Can Tho) is a clinic-software page, skipped. Dong Nai branches of Pet Health Centre not added.
